title: Where those smart-looking tree algorithms came from
text:
By the time four statisticians published the seminal book Classification and Regression Trees in 1984, statisticians had already experimented with algorithms that graphically presented looked like triangle-shaped Christmas trees.
While the Decision Trees series focus primarily on the methodological framework covered in the aforementioned book - and eventually on the currently used modern tree-based algorithms we use today, it is worth taking few steps back to the early history of the tree-based methods and how it all began.
